body:
I am considering to tackle this issue since it seems it needs to be tackled first before the related issue https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/89696 .

> You can remove the marker by calling the register-repository API again, but this API will discard no-op re-registrations without taking any action.

Any pointers in the code as to where this "discard" happens? cc @tlrx

Thanks for volunteering for fixing this.

> > You can remove the marker by calling the register-repository API again, but this API will discard no-op re-registrations without taking any action.
> 
> Any pointers in the code as to where this "discard" happens?

I think that this sentence refers to https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/2a44a8982faa64d8abab770e55c801090195bbf9/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/repositories/RepositoriesService.java#L216-L217

And furthermore, in related issue https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/89696 we discovered that re-registering a repository changes the UUID, which then creates issues when (re-)allocating previous shards of searchable snapshots (that have the older UUID). I think this may be an issue in this case as well?
